description_en: Modifies the weight of a destination route by calling the ModifyVpnRouteEntryWeight operation
description_zh: 调用ModifyVpnRouteEntryWeight接口修改目的路由的权重值
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-vpn-route-entry-weight --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1a3kqjiiq9legfx0000 --route-dest 10.0.0.0/24 --next-hop vco-bp15oes1py4i66rmd0000 --weight 0 --new-weight 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVpnRouteEntryWeight

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VPN gateway instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: VPN网关实例所属地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId value as the ClientToken value. The RequestId value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the destination route
parameters.name: route_dest

parameters.help_en: The next hop of the destination route
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en:
The original weight of the destination route. Valid values:

0: low priority.

100: high priority
parameters.help_zh:
目的路由在修改之前设置的权重值，取值：

0：低优先级。

100：高优先级
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The new weight of the destination route. Valid values:

0: low priority.

100: high priority
parameters.help_zh:
目的路由新的权重值，取值：

0：低优先级。

100：高优先级
parameters.name: new_weight

parameters.help_en: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to Ipsec (IPsec tunneling protocol)
parameters.help_zh: 隧道协议，取值：Ipsec（IPsec隧道协议）
parameters.name: overlay_mode
